_README: swarm-verify config. Copy this to the ROOT of a swarm/project as 'swarm.config.json'
to ARM the pre-flight hook for that directory tree. With NO config present at or
above the cwd, the hook is INERT (prints nothing) -- so installing the toolkit
globally never disrupts a swarm until you opt that tree in by dropping this file.
Delete any keys you don't need; preflight.py ignores unknown keys.
JSON has no comments -- per-key meaning is in _DOC below.

_DOC.canonical_dir: abs path; cwd MUST be inside it or it's a violation (wrong-repo guard). null = skip.
_DOC.stale_dirs: dir names that must NOT be the working root (e.g. 'automation'); match => violation.
_DOC.require_git: true => cwd not inside a git repo is a violation.
_DOC.target_host: optional SSH alias to probe for liveness; null = skip.
_DOC.host_check_cmd: command run via ssh on target_host; success => host ok, failure/timeout => UNKNOWN.
_DOC.require_host: true => target_host UNKNOWN becomes a violation.
_DOC.clock_bounds_days: [past, future] day tolerance published as plausible_epoch_bounds for downstream timestamp sanity-checks.
_DOC.enforcement: 'warn' (inject advisories, never block) | 'block' (a hard violation blocks the swarm launch).
_DOC.state_dir: where STATE.md / state.json / status.json are written (relative to cwd or absolute).
_DOC.ttl_seconds: snapshot freshness; within TTL the hook reuses the cached snapshot (skips re-probing remote hosts).
_DOC.deliverable: defaults the coordinator passes to verify_deliverable.py (see SKILL.md). Not read by preflight.
_DOC.deliverable.max_attempts: self-heal retry budget per task before quarantine (default 2; nested under 'deliverable'). A task spec may carry its own max_attempts to override.
